footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net income to Cryoport: includes $112M from discontinued operations; after $8.0M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 12.4% to $176M in 2025. Gross margin was 47.1%, versus 44.4% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $36.8M from $122M.
Net income was $70.3M, or $1.40 per share, after a $123M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was −$8.6M and free cash flow −$25.0M, versus −$33.6M; Cryoport returned $10.0M through buybacks.
sources: Cryoport, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
